productionQueue.title: AnimalView
productionQueue.notes: AnimalVisualResolver (AnimalInstance -> snapshot, 0 GC, fallback to species default variant, idle phase from seed via SeedHash). Palettes and resolver built at boot. Real rabbit regions and pattern masks. Tests: EditMode 119/119 (SeedHash frozen, idle phase spread, packing, 6 distinct variants, unknown variant fallback, resolve 0 GC, 6 variants on the real prefab share MAT_Animal_Master with no clone and no MaterialPropertyBlock), PlayMode 10/10 (boot with shipped content resolves Spotted, palettes released on destroy).

productionQueue.title: Scheduler
productionQueue.notes: AnimalScheduler (Presentation/Behavior): one Tick per frame from a manager, ticks A 5 Hz / B 1 Hz sliced round-robin, seeded per-agent timers, states Idle/IdleLook/Wander/Eat/Sleep/Wake/Inspect/React/Happy, temperament weights from seed, BehaviorProfile data in DEF_AnimalVisualCatalog, tier budgets per quality (20/30/40 A), smooth walking via SetPose, Poke reaction. Tests: EditMode 132/132 (tick rates, no synchronized spike: max 3 evaluations and 3 changes per frame for 30 agents over 120 s, tiers by distance, determinism, 0 GC), PlayMode 14/14 (30 real rabbits: no per-view Update, sliced ticks, max 4 changes per frame, hop plays when wandering, 0 GC per tick). Editor benchmark 70 rabbits: Scheduler.TickA avg 0.003 ms (max 0.04), TickB avg 0.004 ms (max 0.016); editor GC 17 KB/frame is the editor itself (same with the benchmark disabled). Device numbers pending (T22).

productionQueue.title: Hatch sequence
productionQueue.notes: Hatch sequence: HatchSequencePlayer (waiting pulse, anticipation wobble, crack 1, crack 2 with swell and glow, burst with ballistic fragments, animal pop with overshoot, Happy, celebration), timeline data DEF_HatchPresentation, Common 2.45 s, rarities +0.25 to +0.8 s, repeats x1.6, Skip. EggView + PF_Egg_Base, SH_EggMaster/MAT_Egg_Master, VfxPool + 3 VFX on SH_AdditiveVFXLite, audio/haptic hooks (IAudioService/IHapticService, no-op until clips). PaletteTable now holds eggs. Tests: EditMode 143/143, PlayMode 19/19 incl. 10 hatches after warmup with 0 GC and 0 Instantiate, skip without double events. Capture tool HatchCapture.
